title: Banish
description: Make so your friends disapear from your world instead of banning them.
body:
# **_Banishment Dimension:_**
Banning your problematic friends from your minecraft world is to boring so why not send them to a different dimension and make them earn their place in the overworld again.

## _Features:_
Adds them banishment dimension, a barren place with little to no life. 

**(Spoilers for the dimension) **
 
_The Grimm Forest: _
A dark and confusing place where the only thing that grows are the Grimm Trees, a new type of tree resistent to explosions and the cashew fruit, a not so great food source.

_The Pando Forest:_
It may appear like a normal forest but this connected fungi makes the whole place its own living organism. Its the one of the only places where you can find the Sporeling a tiny living spore that drops a item key to leaving the dimension.

_The Dunes:_
A white desert full of bones and carcasses. Its where you can find the Bone Lizards, a mob that walks in groups and sticks with eachother, they drop a key item to leaving the dimension.

_The Meat Canyon:_
A disturbing place that pulses with tendril and exploding pimples. Its where you can find the Orse, a agressive meat cousin to the Horse, it also drops a very important item to leaving the dimension.

_Ores:_
Gerite: The substitute for normal stone and dirt in the dimension, used to craft stone tools.
Leanite: A green stone used for crafting the Twisted Pedestal.
Trixite: The tuff variant of the dimension.
Starium: A glowing ore used as a base for crafting every important item.
Cryonium: A powerful ore used to craft higher level items.

## **How to Enter:**
 

Craft a Echoing Star and with  it create a Ruined Netherite Sword and then upgrade it to The Banishing Blade, after that kill someone with it and they will be sent to the dimension.

**How to leave:**
(Spoilers)
<details>
<summary>Spoiler</summary>


Craft a Twisted Pedestal and right click with a Pure Star

</details>
